title: Alzheimer's detection from 3D MRI
description: Detecting the stages of Alzheimer's disease from 3D MRI, with the explainability of the decision as the real subject.
detail:
Third-year computer vision project, supervised by Michaël Clément. Detecting the stages of Alzheimer's disease from anonymised 3D brain MRI, comparing the possible strategies: 2D slices, patches, or whole volumes.

What interests me here is not the classification score but the explainability of the decision: identifying which brain regions weigh most in the prediction. It is the direct continuation of my first paper, which compared LIME, SHAP and Grad-CAM.

Just started: data exploration is under way.
